description: Sales already totalled per variant per DAY. Use this for anything about a specific day or a daily trend, such as yesterday, this week, or day by day. It has no location, no order count and no cost, so use shopify_sales when the question needs those. Rows are split by financial_status and fulfillment_status.

p.join: JOIN products p ON p.shopify_product_id = ds.shopify_product_id

pv.join: JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.shopify_variant_id = ds.shopify_variant_id

revenue.description: Sales value after discounts and refunds

gross_revenue.description: Sales value before discounts and refunds

average_unit_price.description: Average price paid per unit before discounts

product.description: The product's own name, which is what people usually mean when they name an item. Anything that looks like a full item name belongs here, not in vendor.

product_type.description: Product category as set in Shopify

vendor.description: The brand or manufacturer on its own, never a full item name. If the text has more words than a brand would, it is a product, not a vendor.

variant.description: Full variant name, which contains the colour and the size

size_label.description: Shoe size as written, for example '27.5CM'. Empty for products that have no size. Use this to group by size

size_cm.description: Shoe size in centimetres as a number. Use this to compare sizes, for example smaller than 24

unit_price.description: Catalogue price of one unit, in rupees

financial_status.description: Payment state of the orders in this row

fulfillment_status.description: Shipping state of the orders in this row

sale_date.description: The day of the sale. Optional grain: day, week, month, year
